about_the_game:
Start your career as a regional First Officer, fighting for good schedules and better pay. Your goal? Build experience, earn your Captain upgrade, and eventually reach a major airline. But in this industry, seniority is everything - and you're starting at zero.

This isn't a flight simulator. It's a pilot career simulator.

Every flight is a series of timed decisions and quick-time events. Handle engine failures, navigate severe turbulence, respond to passenger medical emergencies, and make split-second safety calls. Your performance directly impacts your reputation scores - and one catastrophic failure or series of poor decisions can end your career permanently. Choose wisely.

Bid smart. Fly safe. Build your reputation.

Master the seniority-based schedule bidding system. Senior pilots get first choice - you get what's left. Choose between exhausting four-day trips with better pay or quick turns that keep you home.

Watch your monthly pay grow from peanuts as a regional First Officer to substantial Captain wages. Each flight adds to your total hours. Each successful event builds your reputation. Each level gained makes you a better pilot.

But remember - poor performance affects your scores. Bad scores mean a struggling career.

In an industry where seniority determines your schedule, your base, and your quality of life - can you make it to the left seat?

  • Start at one of three regional airlines, each with different pay scales,  destinations, benefits, perks, and hub cities. Weigh the pros and cons of each mainline and advance to a mainline airline of your choice.

  • Progress from Regional First Officer to Regional Captain to Mainline First Officer to Mainline Captain

  • Age and career progression - start at 25, manage your health and stress, reach mandatory retirement at 65

  • Build five core stats as you level up that affect your career: Stick Skills, Punctuality, Professionalism, Crew Resource Management, Aircraft System Knowledge

  • Four specialized skill trees - Shape your pilot's career path with 16 unlockable abilities: become a Financial powerhouse, a Stress-proof ace, a Career climber, or a Prestige legend - each tree fundamentally changes how you play

  • Complete quick-time events that test your skills and aviation knowledge under pressure

  • Crew and passenger affinity system - Build relationships with recurring crew members and frequent flyers who remember your performance across flights, rewarding consistent excellence with reputation and prestige bonuses as your career develops

  • Manage your finances: monthly salary, savings account, retirement planning

  • Face dynamic events during each flight phase - weather, mechanical issues, passenger situations

  • Track your flights and watch your seniority and paygrade improve with time and experience

  • Navigate living airports with 50+ AI passengers moving through security, finding seats, boarding and deplaning at gates

  • Economic lifestyle system - purchase items that boost prestige, decide between paying high rent in a swanky penthouse or saving money with a crash pad. Manage monthly expenses while building your retirement fund

  • Procedurally generated urban landscapes and terrain - every destination is unique.

  • Dynamic air traffic system - AI aircraft perform full departures and arrivals around you, with pushback, taxi, takeoff rolls, and landing sequences at your airport.

short_description: A pilot career sim-rpg where you climb from regional first officer to mainline captain. Bid for schedules by seniority, handle emergencies through quick-time events, manage finances and stress, and build your reputation with decisions that can make or break your career.
supported_languages:
English*, German, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese - Brazil, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Spanish - Latin America, Traditional Chinese, Turkish, Arabic
*languages with full audio support
